text:
Scam category: Insurance Offer

Typical behaviours: Scammers contact individuals claiming they are interested in providing insurance options. They often ask if the individual has recently lost health care coverage and offer various types of insurance plans.

Distinguishing signals: The caller asks about recent changes to health insurance status and offers a range of insurance products, including dental or critical illness insurance, which may seem overly broad or irrelevant.
